newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam consumer prices drop 0.6 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam consumer prices drop 0.6 pct in April.

text.p: Vietnam's consumer prices fell by 0.6 percent in April after a month-on-month decline of 0.5 percent in March, the official Vietnam News Agency (VNA) said on Sunday.
VNA, quoting the General Department of Statistics, said the decline was led by a 2.8-percent drop in food prices after a bumper winter-spring rice crop in Mekong Delta provinces.
It gave no figure for the year-on-year rate of inflation, which slipped to 2.3 percent last month from 3.7 percent in February.
